# Where the guide stopped working

**File and heading:**

**Documentation revision and Podaro version/commit:**

**Your goal:**

## Instruction followed

Quote the smallest relevant passage or command. State whether you followed it on the Linux host or browsing machine.

## What you expected

Describe the result the guide led you to expect.

## What actually happened

Include a short sanitized error or observation, including the point where you needed outside help or an undocumented prerequisite.

## Environment relevant to this issue

Record distribution, architecture, browser, runtime, or input/assistive technology as appropriate. Do not include private hostnames, credentials, or unrelated personal details.

## Suggested clarification

Propose wording or a missing step when possible. A suggestion is not required to file the issue.

## Testing connection

Name the page and section you followed, and link the test report if there is one. State which steps remain blocked or were skipped.
